title: LiPo pouch cell, low cradle
summary: A low open wall round a LiPo pouch pack, with a gap for the lead. The pack drops in and the lid keeps it down, or a hook-and-loop strap goes over it under two bars beside the wall. Sized from the pouch code on the label (602530 = 6.0 × 25 × 30), with allowances for the protection board and for swelling.

views.label: How it goes in
views.caption: Drag the slider to drop the 602530 pack in. The lead leaves through the gap in the end wall; the bars either side take a 10 wide strap over the pack.

views.label: On a carrier
views.caption: The 602530's carrier: a 4 × 5 plate (40 × 50) with the cradle on it, a window under the pack, and the bridge's posts 36.5 apart beside its long sides. Drag the slider to lower the pack and its bar: in use the pack drops into the cradle first, then the bar (a separate print, 3 mm foam under it) snaps down into the posts and lands on their tops, 8 above the plate. To take it out, press a barb in with a thumbnail or squeeze both and lift the bar off, then lift the pack; the lead leaves through the gap in the end wall, over the plate's edge.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four cradles for the 602530 on open floor pads, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots: three clearances, and the 0.4 again with strap bars.
